notes.content:
Fixes:

[list]
[*]Fixed the critical bug where the game crashed on update
[*]Fixed the bug where furniture placed was not saved inside a building
[*]Fixed the unresponsive/wrong furniture control buttons
[*]Fixed the unresponsive/wrong hovercar control buttons
[*]Fixed the pet animations
[*]Minor fixes in flying monster behaviors
[/list]

Updates:

[list]
[*]Floating islands are added to the open world
[*]Polygon style avatars and a small polygon island is added to the open world
[*]A floating gothic castle is added to the open world
[*]New magic spells were added for the following elements: void, fire, water, ice, earth, electric, nature, dark, sound.

[*]Starting in-game currency is raised from 2000 ZC to 4000 ZC

notes.content:

[list]
[*] Numerous bug fixes for better gaming experience
[/list]

[*]Added Open World map for enhanced aerial combat experience. Players can now traverse in air between the city-islands and combat aerial monsters

notes.title: Patch 0.05
notes.content:
Fixes:

[list]
[*]Fixed the issue where first person camera switch will disable all controls
[*]Fixed the issue where the game crashes when updating cached files
[*]Fixed the bug where autonomous taxi had wrong behavior around obstacles
[/list]

Updates:

[list]
[*]Added swarming invasive flying alien monsters
[*]Improved collisions to be more realistic
[*]Improved aiming rotation
[*]Death/Revive penalty increased to 500 ZC
[*]If player does not have enough currency for revival, the character will be respawned at the starting location
[*]On menu, formerly "Weapon" button text was renamed to "Item"
[*]On menu, formerly "Order" button text was renamed to "Command"
[*]Changed the order of movement and supply skill for easier access
[*]Changed the order of item, skill, command, interact buttons on menu for easier access
[/list]

[previewyoutube=2vKYlwG_qRo;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Patch 0.04
notes.content:
Fixes:

[list]
[*]Fixed RPG launcher bug where RPG did not move and explode
[/list]

Updates:

[list]
[*]NPCs will now drive a hover (flying) taxi and respond to the player's call for a ride
[*]New movement skill Levitation is added - players can now fly around anywhere
[*]New movement skill Teleport is added - players can now teleport (skill level determines the maximum distance)
[*]New movement skill Portal is added - players can now open portals to connect two locations
[*]New movement skill Clairvoyance is added - players can now hawkeye to see anything at any distance without moving
[*]New movement skill World (Beta) is added - players can now travel to different worlds
[*]New support skill Heal is added - players can now heal by converting energy
[*][b]Skill[/b] button added to the menu for easier access to the movement, combat, and support skills
[*]NPCs will now sit at will
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.03
notes.content:
Fixes:

[list]
[*]Fixed the issue where weapon pickup/drop quantity was not working properly
[*]Fixed awkward NPC route finding
[/list]

Updates:

[list]
[*]NPC mind(emotion, action) can now be seen in real time by turning on "Display NPC Minds" flag (Account/Options)
[*]NPC AI(neural network) can be turned on or off by "NPC AI" flag (Account/Options)
[*]All NPCs will now fire back with guns if attacked
[*]Low quality character models are replaced by better models
[*]Weapons can now be deleted by throwing away on the floor by pressing "Drop" button
[*]Characters will now drop the holding weapon if killed
[*]Gun holding animation is added
[/list]
